trap.label: inversão após never
trap.wrong: Never before the board had seen such a loss.
trap.right: Never before had the board seen such a loss.
trap.why: O português não inverte. Em inglês, após never before no início, usa-se had + sujeito.

mcq.q: Never before ___ the board seen such a loss.

fix.wrong: Not only they ignored it, but also hid it.
fix.right: Not only did they ignore it, but they also hid it.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Never before: “The board had not seen such a loss.”
rewrite.answer: Never before had the board seen such a loss.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “They attribute the dip to markets.”
rewrite.answer: The dip is attributed to markets.
